title: Arkret Agent Provision
description: Controller-authored payload that creates one Agent Agent provisioning fact and atomically projects its accountability and controller-scoped selector bindings. The containing Event proof is the only signature; this payload carries no nested proof.

principal_control_realm_id.description: Agent PCR realm id this provision forward-declares. The controller freezes the Agent PCR ak.realm.create envelope locally, computes its event_id and writes retype(event_id, "realm") here; that genesis Event is not yet submitted when this payload is authored, and it MUST be submitted separately afterwards rather than alongside this Event. This is the named class C exemption ak.exemption.preimage_identity.agent_provision_principal_control_realm_id.v1 registered under encoding.md 6.0.1: the genesis preimage carries no reference to this Event, so the dependency stays one-way. Genesis admission reverse-looks-up this declaration; a service MUST NOT choose the value.
